children: , the nation’s fourth largest theatre circuit and a division of
(NYSE: MCS), announced today that it recorded its highest total revenue for the summer moviegoing season in company history, defined as the first Friday in May through Labor Day.
Fueled by blockbuster hits and a diverse slate of summer releases that appealed to a wide range of audiences, summer records set at Marcus Theatres include:
Highest total summer revenue in company history.
Highest box office for any summer.
Highest summer concession, merchandise, and food and beverage revenue of all time.
Highest per capita summer admission revenue and per capita concession, merchandise, and food and beverage spend for the summer moviegoing season.
Highest premium large format screen attendance and percentage of attendance and box office for any summer.

The summer of 2026 finished strong as the top grossing summer domestic box office of all time. We estimate more than 335 million people went to see the latest films on the big screen, showcasing the wide-reaching influence and enduring power of moviegoing, and the significant impact it has on the economy.

“Our outstanding summer performance delivered numerous records and lots of happy moviegoers who enjoyed some of the best performing movies of all time on the big screen,” said Jeff Tomachek, president of Marcus Theatres. “The tremendous turnouts for a wide range of diverse films created unique memory-making moments for all audiences – from the tears to the laughter to the thrills and chills – that cannot be replicated at home. As we look ahead to the rest of the year, several new and highly anticipated films await, giving moviegoers even more reason to enjoy a great time at the movies with friends and family.”

The Marcus Theatres experience stands out for the latest in amenities, technologies, and entertainment offerings. That includes premium large format screens, such as

Screen DLX®, IMAX and ScreenX, DreamLounger® luxury recliner seating, along with a variety of enticing food and beverage options offered at in-theatre dining, bars, and lounges. Marcus Theatres continues to invest in making moviegoing easier, more convenient, and more memorable. In addition to the highest concentration of PLF screens and luxury seating among the top chains, Marcus Theatres also continues to enhance the out-of-home entertainment experience with amenities such as RealD 3D, 4DX, and D-BOX premium haptic and motion seating. The company also recently introduced a new digital ticketing experience online, along with a redesigned website that makes it easier for guests to book their tickets and plan their visit. Together with engaging promotions and programs, these innovations help create memorable movie moments on the big screen.

Marcus Theatres®, a division of Marcus Corporation, is the fourth-largest theatre circuit in the United States and currently owns or operates 975 screens at 77 locations in 17 states under the Marcus Theatres, Movie Tavern® by Marcus and Bistro
® brands. For more information, please visit www.marcustheatres.com and follow the company on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok.

Headquartered in Milwaukee, Marcus Corporation is a leader in the entertainment and hospitality industries, with significant company-owned real estate assets. In addition to its Marcus Theatres division, its hospitality division, Marcus® Hotels & Resorts, owns and/or manages 17 hotels, resorts and other properties in eight states. For more information, please visit the company’s website at www.marcuscorp.com.
